role: Post-open sealed-array diagnostic deciding whether the inadequate Case 19 K16 reference is consistent with monotone under-iteration strongly enough to authorize one fixed K20 reference run.
scientific_question: Does zero-start geometry-Jacobi PCGLS improve from K14 to K16 without absolute-safety or complete-rig tail regressions, and is every remaining K16 failing component close enough that one repeated two-iteration gain would cross its frozen absolute limit?

unique_primary.name: sealed_zero_geometry_jacobi_pcgls_k14_to_k16_monotone_reference_diagnostic
unique_primary.safe_cell_definition: All four cell metrics are finite and less than or equal to strict_cell_limits.
unique_primary.failed_component_definition: A K16 metric component is greater than its strict_cell_limit.
unique_primary.component_gain_definition: K14 metric minus K16 metric; positive values improve with the last two PCGLS iterations.
unique_primary.remaining_gap_definition: K16 metric minus strict_cell_limit for every failed K16 component.
unique_primary.repeat_gain_ratio_definition: remaining_gap divided by component_gain for every failed K16 component.
unique_primary.k20_reason: K20 adds two frozen two-iteration blocks beyond K16: one block corresponding to the registered repeat-gain crossing test and one fixed margin block. K18/K22/K24/K32 are not alternatives in this contract.

formal_method.input: Read only the sealed formal metrics.npy after verifying every parent byte identity.
formal_method.implementation: Use vectorized NumPy masks, method=higher quantiles, and explicit safe-set subset checks.
formal_method.output: Write one JSON report and READY seal in a previously absent output directory on the external disk.

independent_method.input: Read only the separately sealed independent_metrics.npy after the formal report is sealed and after verifying every parent byte identity again.
independent_method.implementation: Use explicit rig/frame/metric loops and sorted-index higher-quantile selection; do not import the formal v245 implementation.
independent_method.required_agreement: All integer counts, safe/failing index sets, component gains, remaining gaps, repeat-gain ratios, rig tails, booleans, and final decision must agree within the frozen comparison tolerances.

decision_order: Any source, protocol, parent identity, shape, dtype, finite, arm, metric, rig/frame count, output-exclusivity, formal-independent, or seal mismatch gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE19_REFERENCE_CONVERGENCE_V245.

If the K16 safe set is not a strict superset of the K14 safe set, any K16 failing component has nonpositive gain, any repeat-gain ratio exceeds 1, or any rig-level metric p90/worst worsens beyond 1e-12, conclude FAIL_CASE19_K16_NOT_MONOTONE_UNDERITERATION_V245 and forbid a deeper fixed reference run under this mechanism.

Only if every validity and monotone-underiteration predicate passes in both implementations may conclude PASS_CASE19_MONOTONE_UNDERITERATION_AUTHORIZES_FIXED_K20_REFERENCE_V245 and authorize one separately frozen K20 reference run.

A pass authorizes only the fixed K20 reference qualification run on already-opened Case 19. It does not authorize a new warm candidate, predictor, wall/RSS, unopened condition, neural model, GPU, external-generalization claim, or real-BOST claim.
failure_action: Close fixed-depth reference deepening for the current global geometry-Jacobi PCGLS mechanism. Do not search K18/K20/K22/K24/K32, tune tolerances, change preconditioning, or use another opened case to rescue the diagnostic.
